items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: He taught me a lot of professional things it would have taken me years and years to learn.

ctx.x: Jack Howard was an influence as far as giving me strength on the piano. He told me always to play the left hand louder than the right because that's where the beat and the feeling was. It's just like a drum keeping a steady beat. He taught me a lot of professional things it would have taken me years and years to learn.
You first met him in Atlanta?
